randomness.upstream_unmodified: std::random_device + std::mt19937 + std::shuffle when the near-surface list is below bounded_batch_size
randomness.seeded_patch: replace only random_device/mt19937 construction with std::mt19937(0x4F55524FU)
randomness.warning: Fixed-seed mode is a controlled reference variant, not byte-identical upstream. Repeatability must still be measured because OpenMP, tie ordering, compiler and floating-point details may remain relevant.

input.grid_positions: bounds are signed i64 microunits; reconstruct coordinate(i)=min+(max-min)*i/(n-1)

non_claims: No benchmark output or performance result is included.
Current face SDF fixture uses the IQ ellipsoid approximation and is not an exact Euclidean SDF.
The maintained method is not equivalent to the classical Rust Hermite/QEF extractor.
A fixed seed is not proof of full-run determinism.
